review: Compared the reopened Blender garden view with the 2023 repair photograph and the two close-up raw-GLB views. Both balcony stacks, side setbacks, separate ground and pavilion casements, the pale projecting canopy, dark tile base and three doorways are visible. The independent door and coffering shots resolve the shorter three-opening screen, square soffit recesses and two upper central lights. The original street image has strong upward perspective; this model scene uses an orthographic view of the measured portion of the south facade.
